simple.meaning: שֶׁבֶת (shebeth) is a Hebrew object word meaning “rest , interruption , cessation.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 21:19. The surrounding context includes Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שֶׁבֶת (H7674) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: שֶׁבֶת (shebeth) / H7674 is traced through Exodus 21:19, Proverbs 20:3, Isaiah 30:7 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed.

definitions.full: H7674. shebeth II. שֶׁ֫בֶת noun feminine cessation (dubious) Prov 20:3 (with ᵐ5 מֵרִיב ἀποστρέφεσθαι = שׁוּב ); שִׁבְתּוֺ Exod 21:19 i.e. from work = his loss of time (but Di I. שֶׁבֶת ). — Isa 30:7 perhaps = a sitting still (indolently) √ ישׁב , but probably corrupt, see Du Che and others
